name: Can You Finish The Hike?
source:
This is a game meant to educate players on various survival tips in a low-stakes fun setting. Everything from poisonous mushrooms to how to use bear spray. Keep your friend safe and happy to reach the end!

[From [url=https://lokittles.itch.io/can-you-finish-the-hike]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本作以轻松有趣、无需承担真实风险的方式，向玩家介绍各种野外生存知识，从有毒蘑菇到防熊喷雾的使用方法，应有尽有。照顾好你的朋友，让对方平安愉快地抵达终点！

[摘自[url=https://lokittles.itch.io/can-you-finish-the-hike]itch.io[/url]]
